aboutGame.title: What is Roblox High School 2?
paragraphs: Roblox High School 2 is a vibrant multiplayer school roleplay simulation developed by Cinder Studio on Roblox. Set in the bustling town of Starcadia Bay, players attend interactive classes, complete subject minigames, earn diplomas, and customize their avatars with an extensive wardrobe.

Beyond academics, players can buy and decorate custom houses, cruise in classic vintage vehicles, work part-time jobs, and explore hidden campus secrets. Our wiki provides complete guides, active codes, and gameplay walkthroughs for every student.

faq.description: Quick answers to common questions about Roblox High School 2.

items.question: What is Roblox High School 2?
items.answer: Roblox High School 2 is a multiplayer school roleplay experience developed by Cinder Studio on Roblox, where players attend classes, earn currency, customize avatars, and decorate homes in Starcadia Bay.

items.question: How do you graduate in Roblox High School 2?
items.answer: To graduate in Roblox High School 2, you must consistently attend classes on time, pass class minigames to maintain good grades, and gain enough XP to unlock the graduation ceremony.

items.question: How do you get free gems and credits in Roblox High School 2?
items.answer: In Roblox High School 2, credits are earned by attending school classes and working part-time jobs, while gems are earned through daily login streaks, leveling up, and redeeming promo codes.

items.question: Where do you redeem codes in Roblox High School 2?
items.answer: In Roblox High School 2, open the in-game menu, look for the Promo or Codes button, enter the code exactly as written, and press redeem to claim your rewards.

items.question: Can you customize houses and vehicles in Roblox High School 2?
items.answer: Yes, Roblox High School 2 provides detailed customization systems for both player homes and vehicles, including interior furniture placement, paint finishes, and performance tuning.
